seo.title: Schwalbe tire selector | Tanzanite
seo.description: Search the sourced Schwalbe tire candidate catalog by model, Article No., ETRTO, or inch designation.

title: Schwalbe tire selector
description: Browse the current Schwalbe English product-page snapshot. Candidate rows remain visible even when the corresponding tire has not been added to the store.

search.label: Search the catalog
search.placeholder: Model, Article No., ETRTO, or inch size
search.hint: Use one complete search term. The API checks Article No., model name, ETRTO, and Inch with OR matching; it does not split multiple words.

states.error: The catalog could not be loaded right now.
states.noResults: No candidates match this single search term.

telemetry.title: How to read these results
telemetry.body: The catalog is an official-source candidate snapshot. A catalog match is not a promise that the item is in stock or compatible with a particular rim.

points.catalog: Candidate facts come from the stored Schwalbe product-page snapshot.
points.sales: The status chip only reports whether a matching store Product exists; prices and stock are not invented for candidates.
points.compatibility: ETRTO, pressure, and construction values are shown as source facts and do not produce a Hookless or rim-compatibility verdict.

telemetryGuide.title: SCHWALBE TELEMETRY GUIDE // 2025/2026 technical catalog map
telemetryGuide.subtitle: Radial labels · model versions · puncture technologies · Compound strings — read from the current catalog snapshot.
telemetryGuide.disclaimer: Counts follow the current catalog or search result. Labels are copied from source fields; they do not create a compatibility, performance, safety, or purchase recommendation.

radial.label: Radial casing · observed labels
radial.title: RADIAL labels in the 2025/2026 catalog snapshot
radial.principleBody: RADIAL is shown here when it appears in a model name or Version field. The catalog does not include casing angles, contact-area tests, pressure comparisons, or performance measurements.
radial.observedBody: Exact model and Version strings remain visible so each result can be checked against its source record.
radial.boundaryBody: Grip, damping, rolling resistance, rim width, and race claims require a specific official document or product page.
radial.snapshotTitle: Source strings grouped in this result
radial.snapshotBody: These groups are counts of exact text matches across model, Version, Compound, Seal, and Tread fields.

green.label: Model names · Green Marathon
green.title: Official model names and Green Marathon fields
green.modelBody: The snapshot contains {count} distinct model_name values. This panel keeps those names as catalog labels instead of turning them into performance or market tiers.
green.marathonBody: When the current result includes Green Marathon, the values below are taken from its stored Version, Compound, Seal, and Tread fields.

protection.label: Protection technologies · source labels
protection.title: Named protection technologies in the snapshot
protection.note: The official protection diagram names technologies and numbered constructions. This catalog only counts matching Version or related source text; it does not infer a level, thickness, material, or flat-less result.
protection.levelBody: Numbered reference from the official protection diagram; the count is the matching Version-label count in this snapshot.
protection.itemBody: Observed as source text on one or more catalog records.

addix.label: ADDIX / Compound · source labels
addix.title: Compound strings preserved exactly
addix.note: Compound is stored and displayed as the official page text. Counts below are exact case-insensitive matches in the current result; performance, color, temperature, and intended-use meanings require their own source.
addix.itemBody: Exact Compound label count in the current result.
